actions.action: Remove the two dead leaves by cutting stems near the base
Filter the light by pulling the plant back a few feet or hanging a sheer curtain
Check soil moisture with a finger 1-2 inches deep before watering
Water thoroughly until it drains when top 1-2 inches are dry, then empty the saucer
Add perlite or bark to the soil at next repot
Move plant gradually toward brighter spots over a week or two
If root rot signs appear, unpot and check the roots

reason: The answer blames light change and treats overwatering as a secondary possibility. Its soil-check watering advice covers part of the fix, but it never suggests a pole. Nothing it recommends is harmful.
